items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Kelly, old man Kelly -- ... Ray Brown, Frank Clarke, and we have another teacher, he's a fantastic bassist, but he never came out to play. He stayed in the public school system with Mr. Kelly.

ctx.x: Well, who else was in the band?
Well, Frank Clarke, this bassist I was telling you about, who began to bring the instruments home. Mr. Kelly, old man Kelly --
